  function updateImageHeights() {
    const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.gradient-outline');

    containers.forEach(container => {
      const img = container.querySelector('img');
      if (!img) return;

      const setHeight = () => {
        const height = img.clientHeight;
        container.style.setProperty('--inner-image-height', `${height}px`);
      };

      // If image is already loaded, set immediately; otherwise, wait for load
      if (img.complete) {
        setHeight();
      } else {
        img.addEventListener('load', setHeight, { once: true });
      }
    });
  }

  // Run on DOM load and window resize
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateImageHeights);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateImageHeights);
</script>

    var utdurgentmessage_buttons = document.querySelectorAll(

      utdurgentmessage_button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        utdurgentmessage_button.classList.toggle("open");

        var content_id = utdurgentmessage_button.getAttribute("aria-controls");
        var utdurgentmessage_content = document.getElementById(content_id);

        toggleARIA(utdurgentmessage_button, "aria-expanded");
        toggleARIA(utdurgentmessage_content, "aria-hidden");
        toggleARIAlabel(utdurgentmessage_button, "aria-label");
      });
    });

    function toggleARIA(element, attribute_name) {
      var current_value = element.getAttribute(attribute_name);
      var new_value = current_value == "true" ? "false" : "true";
      element.setAttribute(attribute_name, new_value);
    }
    function toggleARIAlabel(element, attribute_name) {
      var current_value = element.getAttribute(attribute_name);
      var new_value = current_value == "open message" ? "close message" : "open message";
      element.setAttribute(attribute_name, new_value);
    }

		  const popupClosedTimestamp = localStorage.getItem('popupClosedTimestamp');
  const now = Date.now(); // Get the current time in milliseconds

      // Close all open modal windows

if (window.innerWidth < 768) {

      // Store the last focused element

      // Show the window
      utdurgentmessagemodal.classList.add("utdurgentmessage-modal--visible");
      // Find all focusable children
      var focusableElementsString =
        'a[href], area[href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), button:not([disabled]), iframe, object, embed, [tabindex="0"], [tabindex="-1"], [contenteditable]';
      var focusableElements = utdurgentmessagemodal.querySelectorAll(
        focusableElementsString
      );
      // Convert NodeList to Array
      focusableElements = Array.prototype.slice.call(focusableElements);

      // The first focusable element within the modal window
      var firstTabStop = focusableElements[0];
      // The last focusable element within the modal window
      var lastTabStop = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];
      // Focus the window
      firstTabStop.focus();
      // Add keydown event
      utdurgentmessagemodal.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
        // Listen for the Tab key
        if (e.keyCode === 9) {
          // If Shift + Tab
          if (e.shiftKey) {
            // If the current element in focus is the first focusable element within the modal window...
            if (document.activeElement === firstTabStop) {
              e.preventDefault();
              // ...jump to the last focusable element
              lastTabStop.focus();
            }
            // if Tab
          } else {
            // If the current element in focus is the last focusable element within the modal window...
            if (document.activeElement === lastTabStop) {
              e.preventDefault();
              // ...jump to the first focusable element
              firstTabStop.focus();
            }
          }
        }

        // Close the window by pressing the Esc-key
        if (e.keyCode === 27) {
          removeModalutdurgentmessage();
        }
      });
    }

<script>
  function updateImageHeights() {
    const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.gradient-outline');

    containers.forEach(container => {
      const img = container.querySelector('img');
      if (!img) return;

      const setHeight = () => {
        const height = img.clientHeight;
        container.style.setProperty('--inner-image-height', `${height}px`);
      };

      // If image is already loaded, set immediately; otherwise, wait for load
      if (img.complete) {
        setHeight();
      } else {
        img.addEventListener('load', setHeight, { once: true });
      }
    });
  }

  // Run on DOM load and window resize
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateImageHeights);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateImageHeights);
</script>

<script>
    var utdurgentmessage_buttons = document.querySelectorAll(
      ".utdurgentmessage-button"
    );

    [].forEach.call(utdurgentmessage_buttons, function(utdurgentmessage_button) {
      utdurgentmessage_button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        utdurgentmessage_button.classList.toggle("open");

        var content_id = utdurgentmessage_button.getAttribute("aria-controls");
        var utdurgentmessage_content = document.getElementById(content_id);
        utdurgentmessage_content.classList.toggle("open");

        toggleARIA(utdurgentmessage_button, "aria-expanded");
        toggleARIA(utdurgentmessage_content, "aria-hidden");
        toggleARIAlabel(utdurgentmessage_button, "aria-label");
      });
    });

    function toggleARIA(element, attribute_name) {
      var current_value = element.getAttribute(attribute_name);
      var new_value = current_value == "true" ? "false" : "true";
      element.setAttribute(attribute_name, new_value);
    }
    function toggleARIAlabel(element, attribute_name) {
      var current_value = element.getAttribute(attribute_name);
      var new_value = current_value == "open message" ? "close message" : "open message";
      element.setAttribute(attribute_name, new_value);
    }
    // Button to trigger the modal window
    var button = document.querySelector(".utdurgentmessage-modal__show");
    var lastFocusedElement;
    var closeButton = document.querySelector(".utdurgentmessage-modal__close");

      removeModalutdurgentmessage();

if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
	return;
}
  

      // Store the last focused element
      lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;

  function updateImageHeights() {
    const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.gradient-outline');

    containers.forEach(container => {
      const img = container.querySelector('img');
      if (!img) return;

      const setHeight = () => {
        const height = img.clientHeight;
        container.style.setProperty('--inner-image-height', `${height}px`);
      };

      // If image is already loaded, set immediately; otherwise, wait for load
      if (img.complete) {
        setHeight();
      } else {
        img.addEventListener('load', setHeight, { once: true });
      }
    });
  }

  // Run on DOM load and window resize
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateImageHeights);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateImageHeights);
</script>

<script>
  function updateImageHeights() {
    const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.gradient-outline');

    containers.forEach(container => {
      const img = container.querySelector('img');
      if (!img) return;

      const setHeight = () => {
        const height = img.clientHeight;
        container.style.setProperty('--inner-image-height', `${height}px`);
      };

      // If image is already loaded, set immediately; otherwise, wait for load
      if (img.complete) {
        setHeight();
      } else {
        img.addEventListener('load', setHeight, { once: true });
      }
    });
  }

  // Run on DOM load and window resize
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateImageHeights);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateImageHeights);
</script>

    function toggleARIA(element, attribute_name) {
      var current_value = element.getAttribute(attribute_name);
      var new_value = current_value == "true" ? "false" : "true";
      element.setAttribute(attribute_name, new_value);
    }
    function toggleARIAlabel(element, attribute_name) {
      var current_value = element.getAttribute(attribute_name);
      var new_value = current_value == "open message" ? "close message" : "open message";

		  const popupClosedTimestamp = localStorage.getItem('popupClosedTimestamp');

      removeModalutdurgentmessage();

if (window.innerWidth < 768) {

      lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;

      var utdurgentmessagemodal = document.getElementById("utdurgentmessage-modal");
      // Show the window
      utdurgentmessagemodal.classList.add("utdurgentmessage-modal--visible");
      // Find all focusable children
      var focusableElementsString =
        'a[href], area[href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), button:not([disabled]), iframe, object, embed, [tabindex="0"], [tabindex="-1"], [contenteditable]';
      var focusableElements = utdurgentmessagemodal.querySelectorAll(
        focusableElementsString
      );
      // Convert NodeList to Array
      focusableElements = Array.prototype.slice.call(focusableElements);

      // The first focusable element within the modal window
      var firstTabStop = focusableElements[0];
      // The last focusable element within the modal window
      var lastTabStop = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];
      // Focus the window
      firstTabStop.focus();
      // Add keydown event
      utdurgentmessagemodal.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
        // Listen for the Tab key
        if (e.keyCode === 9) {
          // If Shift + Tab
          if (e.shiftKey) {
            // If the current element in focus is the first focusable element within the modal window...
            if (document.activeElement === firstTabStop) {
              e.preventDefault();
              // ...jump to the last focusable element
              lastTabStop.focus();
            }
            // if Tab
          } else {
            // If the current element in focus is the last focusable element within the modal window...
            if (document.activeElement === lastTabStop) {
              e.preventDefault();
              // ...jump to the first focusable element
              firstTabStop.focus();
            }
          }
        }

        // Close the window by pressing the Esc-key
        if (e.keyCode === 27) {
          removeModalutdurgentmessage();
        }
      });
    }

<script>
  function updateImageHeights() {
    const containers = document.querySelectorAll('.gradient-outline');

    containers.forEach(container => {
      const img = container.querySelector('img');
      if (!img) return;

      const setHeight = () => {
        const height = img.clientHeight;
        container.style.setProperty('--inner-image-height', `${height}px`);
      };

      // If image is already loaded, set immediately; otherwise, wait for load
      if (img.complete) {
        setHeight();
      } else {
        img.addEventListener('load', setHeight, { once: true });
      }
    });
  }

  // Run on DOM load and window resize
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateImageHeights);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateImageHeights);
</script>
